name: accordion-25
description: Team directory where departments expand into member rows with avatars and roles.

import { ChevronDownIcon, MessageCircleIcon } from "lucide-react" import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, } from "@workspace/ui/components/accordion" import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarGroup, } from "@workspace/ui/components/avatar" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" const teams = [ { value: "design", name: "Design", members: [ { name: "Ivy Tran", role: "Design lead" }, { name: "Noah Becker", role: "Product designer" }, { name: "Sana Malik", role: "Brand designer" }, ], }, { value: "engineering", name: "Engineering", members: [ { name: "Marcus Hale", role: "Staff engineer" }, { name: "Elena Ruiz", role: "Frontend engineer" }, ], }, ] const initials = (name: string) => name .split(" ") .map((part) => part[0]) .join("") export default function AccordionTeamDirectory() { return ( {teams.map((team) => ( {team.name} {team.members.map((member) => ( {initials(member.name)} ))} {team.members.map((member) => (
{initials(member.name)}

{member.name}

{member.role}

))} ))} ) }
